<?php
/**
 * Case In Paint commission form handler (Bluehost / PHP mail()).
 * Generated by build.py from templates/contact.php.txt.
 */
declare(strict_types=1);

$TO     = '{{ site.email }}';
$FROM   = '{{ site.email }}';          // must be a real mailbox on this domain for Bluehost to send it
$BASE   = '{{ base }}';
$THANKS = $BASE . 'commissions/thanks/';
$BACK   = $BASE . 'commissions/';

function go(string $to): void { header('Location: ' . $to, true, 303); exit; }
function field(string $key, int $max = 5000): string {
    $v = isset($_POST[$key]) && is_string($_POST[$key]) ? $_POST[$key] : '';
    return trim(mb_substr($v, 0, $max));
}
function one_line(string $v): string { return trim(preg_replace('/[\r\n\t]+/', ' ', $v)); }

if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== 'POST') { go($BACK); }

// Spam traps: a hidden field humans never fill in, and a page-load timestamp set by JS.
if (field('website') !== '') { go($THANKS); }
$t = (int) field('t', 20);
if ($t > 0 && (time() - $t) < 3) { go($THANKS); }

$name     = one_line(field('name', 120));
$email    = one_line(field('email', 200));
$type     = one_line(field('type', 60));
$deadline = one_line(field('deadline', 200));
$message  = field('message', 5000);

if ($name === '' || $message === '' || !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
    go($BACK . '?error=1#form-title');
}

$subject = 'Commission inquiry: ' . ($type !== '' ? $type : 'New project') . ' from ' . $name;
$body = "Name: {$name}\nEmail: {$email}\nProject type: {$type}\nDeadline: " . ($deadline !== '' ? $deadline : 'none given') .
        "\n\n{$message}\n\n--\nSent from the form on caseinpaint.net ({$_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']})\n";

$headers = [
    'From: Case In Paint website <' . $FROM . '>',
    'Reply-To: ' . $name . ' <' . $email . '>',
    'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8',
    'X-Mailer: caseinpaint.net',
];

$ok = mail($TO, '=?UTF-8?B?' . base64_encode($subject) . '?=', $body, implode("\r\n", $headers), '-f' . $FROM);
go($ok ? $THANKS : $BACK . '?error=1#form-title');
